summary.content:
Today's selection covers 88 articles from 8 trusted sources, including 52 on Artificial Intelligence and 15 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: U.S. Loosens Restrictions on Anthropic’s Mythos A.I. Model
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: Chinese Framework Powers 200,000 Scam Sites
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, phishing, data breaches
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from NY Times Tech, The Verge, TechCrunch, Dark Reading, BBC Technology and others
• **Fresh Content**: 12 articles published in the last 24 hours
